question: Can I use evoke when I cast a spell without paying its mana cost?

expected.shortAnswer: No: if you cast a spell without paying its mana cost, you cannot use its evoke ability.
expected.answer: If you're casting a spell "without paying its mana cost," you can't use its evoke ability.

whyHard: Evoke is an alternative cost, so it cannot be combined with another alternative cost such as casting for free.
